title: Logistics: Core Loop
summary: Move items by rule, watch buffers, and fix jams before expanding routes.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Tag storage, define loadouts, bind route manifests, scan readiness, and use remote requests when the network can fulfill the kit.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each route change, check whether the right items arrived, the wrong items stayed out, and the buffer can survive a delay.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop before adding a route you cannot explain. A simple, labeled network is worth more than a fast one that only works by accident.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
